errata.error: JMA's historical file for Saigo in October 1980 stamps its 22nd line as the 20th, between lines stamped the 21st and 23rd.
errata.response: The line is read as the 22nd, since the lines on either side are stamped the 21st and 23rd.
errata.evidence: The file is `sea_lev_var/1980/198010/hry198010SA.txt`. Its 22nd line, stamped `801020SA`, sits between lines stamped `801021SA` and `801023SA`; the backfill of 1924–2026 failed on it with "not a day, or a day twice". [#57](https://github.com/openwatersio/stillwell/pull/57) reads it as the 22nd.
errata.report: Submitted through JMA's web feedback form on 2026-11-08. No answer yet. Text in [#58](https://github.com/openwatersio/stillwell/issues/58).
